history.body: Hi, we saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting a small place and looking for our first home with our young child. The three-bedroom layout caught our eye—do you have a show unit we could walk through?

That sounds like a sensible first home to explore for your family. Type A is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms; the open-plan living and dining area gives you a shared family space, while the bedrooms keep sleeping space separate. I’ll check whether a show unit is available to walk through.
That sounds promising, especially having three bedrooms for our little one. If a show unit is available, we’d be interested in seeing how the rooms feel in person. Let us know what you find out?

Absolutely—I’m still waiting for confirmation about the show unit, so I can’t confirm a walk-through just yet. If it’s available, seeing the three bedrooms and open living and dining area in person should help you picture how the layout could work for your family. I’ll update you once I have confirmation.
